children: Swiss Life plans to cut around 600 jobs by the end of 2028, in a move to boost efficiency and profitability.
The reduction will take place largely through natural attrition, with about half of the cuts expected in Switzerland, the Swiss insurer said Tuesday.
At the end of 2025, Swiss Life had the equivalent of roughly 11,000 full-time positions worldwide and a network of around 17,000 advisers, according to its website.
Swiss Life said it expects around 100 redundancies by the end of this year.
